notes: Pairing identity and device names: DATA/devices written whole (renamed in), a failed or empty read answered 'try again', never 'revoked'; a device never removes itself; the app identity read three times, written whole, an unreadable one kept aside; the link retries an unreadable pairing file with backoff (phone, desktop). Names from the OS: a new pairing is named by Android's device name (Settings.Global device_name, Bluetooth name, model) or the Windows computer name; pairing again with a known name replaces that entry (old token revoked, name kept, never -2); label ops (the OS name by default, the Pi's hostname; Devices page Rename -> cmd rename) shown on the Devices page.
